name: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
summary: Welcome to CrunchLabs, a science playground where former NASA engineer turned creator Mark Rober tackles challenges that push creativity to the limit.

previousepisode.name: I Spent $5M So You Can Go to Space

name: Capsized
summary: Set in the elite world of girl's high school rowing, Capsized follows Jo Bryant, a spitfire novice, and Margaret Douglas, the polished varsity captain, as they and their teammates unravel a dark secret behind their coach's legacy and train for the annual Head of the Charles Regatta.

name: Elegy for the Henchmen: Fist of the North Star
summary: 199X. The world is engulfed in nuclear flames, making mere survival a struggle. In this chaotic world, the protagonist Nobu finds a job none other than with the "King of Fists Army"! How long can Nobu survive in this dangerous workplace where more people die than apply ...? A cast of unique thugs appear one after another , including a thug disguised as an old woman, Cassandra's Uighur prison warden, and the Holy Emperor Army's "filth disinfection guy" !!

name: Bill's Included
summary:
Bill's Included follows Bill Beam, a well meaning but over enthusiastic divorcee who rents his spare rooms to students to stay afloat.

As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.

name: Monstress
summary: Set in an Asian-inspired fantasy world, Monstress tells the story of a young woman with a literal monster living inside of her. On a quest to understand her past and avenge her mother's murder, she's joined by a colorful ensemble including a talking cat and a hybrid fox/human girl as they're thrown in the middle of a war between human and otherworldly forces. When the world turns us into monsters, Monstress asks how can we overcome our monstrosities?

name: FPJ's Batang Quiapo
summary: A young man rises to be one of the biggest outlaws in the neighborhood while he navigates his way in life to survive in Quiapo. Hoping to earn the affection of his parents, his feat draws him closer to the truth about his identity.

name: FPJ's Batang Quiapo: Unang Yugto
summary: FPJ's Batang Quiapo: Unang Yugto is a fast-paced, limited series that follows Tanggol, a young man raised in the dangerous streets of Quiapo, as he navigates the challenges of love, family, and survival.

name: Inside Britain's National Parks
summary: A look at four of Britain's 15 national parks, capturing these unique places and meeting the people who live and work in the New Forest, Pembrokeshire Coast, Dartmoor and Northumberland.

name: Golden City
summary: It tells how the three best friends (brothers) beat the world with their bare hands in the early 1960s to 1970s. The love stories of their generation connects to the next generation. The common emotions and memories between the two generations also highlights and explores the differences in their life values.

name: Dickens
summary:
The bold new series will explore how Dickens, a restless insomniac and obsessive night walker, drew inspiration from the people and stories he encountered in Victorian London after dark. It shows how the characters he encountered on the streets, as well as in London's busy courts and jails, both shaped his stories and sharpened his keen sense of social injustice.

Running alongside the story of his exploration of London is the story of Dickens' creative evolution, revealing how real-life events informed some of literature's most enduring works, from Oliver Twist and David Copperfield to A Christmas Carol. The series will revisit the pivotal and often shocking moments he experienced first-hand, from his experiences in a boot blacking factory as a child to the 1849 Tooting cholera outbreak he reported on as a journalist.

name: The Koreans
summary: Set during the wave of democratization and cultural modernization that swept across South Korea in the early 1990s, The Koreans will follow a middle-class family hiding a treasonous secret. While seemingly ordinary citizens in the eyes of their friends, neighbors and even their children, both parents actually are elite North Korean spies working to bring down the South from within. Highlighting the stark difference between these two formerly united countries, the series will follow the spies as they wrestle with conflicting feelings of patriotism, loyalty, identity and love, while a ruthless Korean counterintelligence agent draws ever closer to discovering their identities.

name: App me als je thuis bent
summary: In this painfully timely documentary series, women break the silence regarding the impact of sexual violence on the streets. Sexual assault cases from the past and present reveal how deeply women's lives have been affected. With unprecedented candor, women speak about the trauma, the road to healing, and justice.

name: The Scandal
summary: In Joseon's world of rank and reputation, an aristocratic wife and an infamous libertine pull a reserved lady into a scheme where love turns dangerous.

name: El depredador de Sevilla
summary: A sexual assault by a Spanish tour guide sparks a surge of similar claims from multiple US students. This documentary follows their fight for justice.

name: La acusación
summary: The limited series centres on the Sellés family, who belong to the well-off bourgeoisie, are well integrated into their city, and enjoy the esteem and respect of high society. Their perfect façade crumbles when Jaime, the model son, is accused of a terrible crime. While public opinion condemns him and the family falls apart under media pressure and social isolation, Mina, his cousin and a criminal lawyer, decides to defend him, convinced of his innocence. Over the course of the trial, the Sellés will be forced to unearth their past to find out whether Jaime is truly guilty.

name: Two Birds
summary:
Set against the rarely-seen-on-screen landscape of Kalgoorlie, a remote Australian mining town carved from red earth, where rusted shafts and weatherboard pubs fade into endless bush, this harsh, beautiful, and isolating world clings tightly to its secrets.

The series centres on British Police Constable Izzie Cornwell, who arrives in the small fictional town of Dugdale having been recently widowed and intent on a fresh start and a new life in Australia.

Focused upon chasing away her grief, Izzie hopes to reconnect with her sister who moved to the Kalgoorlie area with her Australian husband, and most important of all, to rebuild trust with her twenty-year-old daughter, who is scared by her mother's recent destructive behaviour.  

Izzie is assigned to investigate a murder alongside her new boss Matt, a Homicide Detective from Perth. When the victim is revealed to be part of a notorious local crime family, led by the formidable Mrs Baxter, the stakes intensify. 

Determined to protect her family and uncover the truth, Mrs Baxter exerts fierce pressure on the case. 

But the night before Izzie joins the case, one reckless last hurrah goes disastrously wrong and a split-second decision results in consequences Izzie can't undo, forcing her into a secret she must do everything to contain.

name: La fiscal
summary: This documentary series goes deep into the new office created to combat femicide and exposes the harsh reality of violence against women in Mexico City.

name: Die SS - Zwischen Macht und Mythos
summary:
The SS was the Nazi state's instrument of domination and oppression, responsible for the intelligence services and the police. The SS committed a horrific range of atrocities, including the Holocaust, the persecution of political opponents, and brutal war crimes. Millions of people were victims of the Schutzstaffel, and many of the perpetrators were unrepentant to the end.

This six-part documentary provides a comprehensive overview of the SS, describing how a small group of thugs rose to become the most feared organ in the Nazi state. With the help of international experts, the film examines common myths about the organisation. Interviews with eyewitnesses and unapologetic perpetrators take us closer to the psyche of the SS supporters in an attempt to make the inconceivable comprehensible.

previousepisode.name: Unrepentant: The SS and Its Myth After 1945

name: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
summary: Bertia is reincarnated into her favorite otome game—not as the heroine, but as the villainess engaged to the perfect Crown Prince Cecil! Fully aware that her role is to sabotage his future romance, she's determined to bloom as a wicked flower and wither away according to the story. But no matter how hard she tries to scheme, her "evil" plans only make her more endearing!

previousepisode.name: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess as a Wife.

name: Eren the Southpaw
summary: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.

previousepisode.name: To All the People Who Couldn't Become Geniuses

name: I Want to End this Love Game
summary: Childhood friends Yukiya and Miku share everything…except their feelings. Ever since sixth grade, they've played a "love game": they take turns saying "I love you" and whoever gets flustered first loses. Now in high school, their hearts are closer than ever—but will they finally find the courage to confess?

name: The Drops of God
summary: When world-renowned wine critic Toyotaka Kanzaki passes away, he leaves behind an enviable collection. The will promises his estate to whoever correctly guesses the brand and year of the 12 greatest wines he selected, and the legendary wine that stands atop them all, "Drops of God." The challengers are Toyotaka's son, Shizuku Kanzaki, and a young critic, Issei Tomine, who was adopted by Toyotaka.

previousepisode.name: A Light on a Long Road

name: A Hundred Scenes of AWAJIMA
summary: At Awajima Opera School, girls from across Japan strive to earn a place on stage. Wakana is driven by her love of musical theater, while Kinue studies with quiet discipline. Scholarship student Emi draws attention from all—but especially from Keiko, who struggles with admiration and comparison. Through shifting perspectives, their intertwined days explore ambition, friendship, and self-discovery.

name: Bayn Al Qosour
summary: Sakina is a girl from a poor family who lives in a popular neighborhood. Sakina is exposed to a strong shock in her adolescent, which radically changes the course of her life. Years later, life circumstances force her to return to her hometown, "Bayn Al Qosour" Sakina confronts her painful past and seeks to know the truth about what happened to her in her childhood.

name: GHOST CONCERT: Missing Songs
summary: The year is 2045. Singing is forbidden, and an AI system called MiucS creates music in place of people. Seria Aiba, a high school girl who can see spirits, lives quietly under these rules—until one day, she hears a real human voice singing. Following the song, Seria discovers the source: a ghost. Now Seria must decide whether to stay silent or risk everything to bring music back to the world.

previousepisode.name: Each Blossoms in Their Own Way

name: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
summary: After a mysterious incident drives her from her job at a British mansion, Suzume moves into a small apartment and begins a new life in Japan. Curious about her new surroundings, she dives into the country's vibrant food culture. From local diners to street stalls, Suzume discovers new flavors, meets colorful people, and finds joy in life one meal at a time.

previousepisode.name: Gyoza, Dried Daikon, Instant Noodles, and Year-End Soba

name: Кулинарная битва
summary:
"Cooking Battle" is a cooking show in which Konstantin Ivlev will test the recipes of food bloggers live.

In each episode, he will choose three video recipes from the internet and, together with a team of professional chefs, prepare them exactly as they are. During the cooking process, Ivlev will monitor the execution, and at the end of the episode, he will taste each dish and choose the winner of the episode, the best recipe in its culinary category.

The author of the winning video will receive a prize from Konstantin Ivlev.

name: ПОПРОБУЙ РАССМЕШИ
summary: Stand-up comedian Timur Dzhankyozov is traveling to cities, villages, and towns in various parts of our country, where people have never seen stand-up comedy live and may not be ready for this type of humor or be skeptical. Timur will explore the culture, daily life, problems, and gossip of the locals, immersing himself in their lives to create a stand-up performance and try to make them laugh! This is the "Try to Make Me Laugh" show. Enjoy your viewing!

name: Needy Girl Overdose
summary: In a world where likes are currency and every viewer is a judge, OMGkawaiiAngel—also known as KAngel—is determined to become the ultimate "Internet Angel." Yet beneath her pastel smile and lively streams, there's more than meets the eye.

name: Pearl in Red
summary: Pearl in Red tells the story of Kim Dan-hee and Baek Jin-ju, who both seek revenge against the Adel Group by infiltrating the company under false identities after losing a beloved family member.

name: Secret Garden
summary:
To experience epic animal adventures, there's no need to travel the globe. Some of the greatest natural dramas are happening much closer to home.

Britain's 30 million gardens have a combined area greater than all of our national nature reserves combined. And it turns out that our flowerbeds, vegetable patches, lawns and ponds are home to thousands of animal and plant species - many rarely seen, most barely understood.

Secret Garden tells the surprising stories of the wild characters that live right on our doorsteps, revealing what they get up to when our backs are turned.

name: Anime Pilgrims
summary: Join our Anime Pilgrims on a journey to where fiction meets reality. The real-life settings of iconic anime productions offer a glimpse into Japan's deep culture, history, and hidden charms.

name: A Mile in Your Shoes
summary: This program focuses on foreign residents in Japan who tackle the issues the country faces, driven by their love for their community of adoption and their ability to put themselves in Japanese shoes.

previousepisode.name: A Store Stocked with Flavors and Hope

name: Love Scandal
summary: When the fine line between "work" and "feelings" begins to blur, a secret relationship between a model and his manager begins.

name: Tenball
summary: Tenball was an ITV game show combining snooker and pool, where eight professional players competed in a knockout tournament.

name: Building Back America's Trades
summary: Building Back America's Trades chronicles the stories of students, mentors, and teachers as they remake the trades industry and themselves. In the premiere, veterans, women and working professionals stand shoulder to shoulder as they rebuild their lives and industries through overlooked opportunities in the skilled trades.

name: First Letter First
summary: Comedian Don Maclean presents a new style of word game which demands speed of mind and hand. Contestants must not only know the answer, but also be first to press the initial letter on a computer keyboard.

name: You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg
summary: You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg, a comprehensive look at the life and career of American soccer legend Clint Dempsey. The five-episode series traces Dempsey's dramatic and improbable journey from a trailer park in Nacogdoches, Texas to starring for the U.S. at the FIFA World Cup.

previousepisode.name: Le Grand Restaurant : La guerre de l'étoile

name: The Black Tower
summary: Frustrated with his career, Commander Dalgliesh is invited to Toynton Grange, a home for the disabled, by his old teacher, Father Baddeley, who is resident there. But unbeknown to Dalgliesh, something happening at the Grange is making the Father uneasy, and Dalgliesh quickly finds himself investigating a series of mysterious deaths.

name: A Taste for Death
summary: Sir Paul Berowne - a prominent Government Minister - turns to his old friend Adam Dalgleish following a series of threatening letters delivered to his London home. The minister's wife is in an adulterous affair with a prominent surgeon and she makes no secret of it. Berowne's only daughter is involved in left-wing politics and rejects her conservative father. Adding to his woes, his own mother favoured her son who was killed in an IRA terrorist ambush over Paul. The informal investigation has barely began when Dalgliesh is faced with a series of bizarre deaths that turn the case into an urgent assignment.

name: A Certain Justice
summary: Commander Adam Dalgliesh is drawn into the inner chambers of the British legal system to investigate the grisly murder of Venetia Aldridge, an ambitious - and widely despised - criminal lawyer. As the list of suspects quickly grows to include several key members of Aldridge's firm, each with an excellent motive for murder, suspicion also falls on Gary Ashe, a murder suspect Venetia recently defended - successfully - and who has since taken up with her daughter Octavia. As Dalgliesh probes Venetia's past, a terrible secret about her father emerges and appears to be linked to her death - as well as to a distinguished member of Chambers.

name: Delikanlı
summary: Yusuf, who grew up in the suburbs of Istanbul, is a young man who tries to keep his family afloat and does not bow to injustice. While he dreams of a modest life with his childhood sweetheart Hazan, fate drags him into the middle of the underworld, power games and class conflict. When he reappears years later with a completely different identity, nothing is the same anymore; The wounds of the past and the hidden secrets will force him to follow both his heart and his revenge.

name: Tomb Raider King
summary: Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

name: Shadow of Love
summary: Their relationship began with a lack of affection, but living in the same family and bonding with each other led to feelings that transcended the usual sibling dynamic. Despite their attempts to restrain their feelings, they were unable to resist their feelings for each other.

name: Y'a que la vérité qui compte
summary: Y'a que la vérité qui compte, ordinary people come onto a television set to reveal a secret, confess their feelings, or try to reconnect with a loved one. Standing before the legendary "curtain," the participant must face the truth in front of the guest of their choice, with Pascal Bataille and Laurent Fontaine serving as arbiters.

name: Detective
summary: Anthology series featuring adaptations of detective stories.

name: Missing from Home
summary: Drama serial about a middle-aged housewife who has to cope alone when her husband disappears.

name: Creature Kid
summary: From buffalo to butterflies, this draw-along show goes step-by-step through drawing all the coolest creatures. Follow along with Justin as he draws amazing animals!

name: Iggy and Mr. Kirk
summary: Laugh, learn, sing, and play along with Iggy the Iguana in Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Watch as Iggy discovers the importance of honesty, forgiveness, bravery, and more! Iggy may not have it all figured out, but thanks to Mr. Kirk, Iggy's friends, and some great Freedom Island stories, he'll grow a little more each day.

name: Onze Man bij de Vijand
summary: Russia is at war. Western journalists are barely left. Thomas Erdbrink was allowed to travel freely through Russia for a year without visible interference from the authorities. Together with director Roel van Broekhoven, he investigates what it is like to live in a country where war dictates everything and silence is safer than speaking.

name: City of Blood
summary: Estranged sisters Bea and Phoebe uncover a terrifying truth: Vampires control Berlin.

name: The End
summary: The End is Ari Shaffir's live storytelling show featuring some of comedy's biggest names sharing the wildest true stories you've ever heard. Raw, hilarious, and completely unfiltered, the series spans seven hour-long episodes plus a bonus prologue, with comedians including Shane Gillis, Nate Bargatze, Tom Segura, Tony Hinchcliffe, and many more.

name: The Dark Wizard
summary:
The Dark Wizard is an up-close and unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, one of the world's most influential and controversial climbers, BASE jumpers, and highline walkers. The series traces the jaw‑dropping feats that made him a legend, as well as the personal turmoil that defined his life.

From an early age, Dean grappled with inner demons that led him to seek the limits of human possibility. Climbing became his outlet and Yosemite National Park became the canvas for his unique talent and artistic expression. As his accomplishments on El Capitan and Half Dome elevated him to hero status in the adventure sports world, his mental state began to fracture and his fierce competitive drive pushed him to try to outdo both himself and others, including rising star Alex Honnold. Ultimately, it was wingsuiting and his lifelong desire to fly that would prove to be his riskiest and most transcendent endeavor.

name: Should I Marry a Murderer?
summary: A fiancée turned key witness reveals how she stayed engaged to a man accused of murder while gathering evidence against him in this documentary series.

name: The Heat Is On
summary: The Heat Is On is a six-part reality series in which 14 strangers aim to prove themselves by completing a punishing SAS-style training regime.

name: The Lord's Day
summary: On the State Opening of Parliament, British spy Harry Jones finds himself inside the iconic building amidst a lockdown. As the siege escalates, loyalties are tested and selfless sacrifices are made, leading to a desperate fight for survival where not everyone will emerge alive. Can Harry use his skills and training to be the country's saviour?

name: Miles That Matter
summary: Hit the road with three of basketball's brightest stars at different stages of their careers: Azzi Fudd, Trey McKenney, and Napheesa Collier. Each episode offers an intimate look at the athlete's life beyond the arena as they navigate their hometowns alongside the family and coaches who helped pave their way. From the school gyms of Flint and Arlington to the farm roads of Missouri, we explore the legacy, the community, and the miles that made them into champions.

name: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
summary: Just as His Highness's favored butterfly Reirin is beloved by the prince, jealous "court sewer rat" Keigetsu uses magic to swap their bodies—and their destinies. With a looming execution, Reirin embraces her new, healthy body, while Keigetsu learns Reirin's life isn't what it seems as she's pulled into an inner-court conspiracy.

name: Ronan Keating's Wild Atlantic
summary:
Ronan Keating's Wild Atlantic takes audiences on an epic journey around the west coast of Ireland.

This surprising, fun and at times emotional series offers an insight into Ronan's childhood and family life as he visits Cork, Kerry, Mayo, Sligo, Donegal and Londonderry.

name: I Flower You
summary: A funeral event organizer falls head over heels for a florist's son, but every time he tries to express his love through flowers, they end up being mistaken for funeral wreath arrangements instead. Phak, a young man who decides to move back to his hometown to start a funeral organizing business, meets Nich, a gentle and detail-oriented florist who teaches him the meaning of "love at first sight." By chance, the two end up working together despite their differences. But will those differences turn into the perfect fit? Phak, who has never been in love before, finds that courting Nich is anything but easy. To make matters more complicated, Wit, a charming young veterinarian, steps in as a rival for Nich's heart. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Kanchanaburi, will Phak be able to win Nich's heart?

name: Transfer Student Nanno
summary: Follows Nanno, an enigmatic transfer student whose uncanny insight into the moral failings of those around her drives each episode's reckoning as she moves between schools.

name: Tabi to Boku to Neko
summary: After wishing upon a star to be able to talk to his childhood cat, he learns to speak with cats. He becomes a travel writer introducing places the cats told him about.

name: Call the Midwife: Sisters in Arms
summary:
In September 1939, Sister Monica Joan is in her prime, Sister Julienne and Sister Evangelina are young and zealous, and Nonnatus House is the beating heart of Poplar. Together with Sister Alice, and local GP Dr Kit, the nuns dedicate their lives to mothers, babies and the poor. But there is no gas and air, no penicillin, no cure for TB, and no welfare state. Then war is declared - and life gets even harder.

The three young secular midwives who complete the team - Sybil, Olive and Marianne - receive a baptism of fire as the blackout and the Blitz take hold. While bombs rain from the sky, women give birth underground, families are shattered, children run wild, and whole streets are reduced to rubble. But courage, compassion and resilience triumph as the community unites in its efforts to survive.

name: Stray Kids: Mysterious Kitchen
summary: Han, I.N and Lee Know in charge of the kitchen of JYPE.

name: Lle Bach Mawr
summary:
Covid-19 and the fact that many of us won't be going away on a foreign holiday this year means that we'll be spending more time in our homes and gardens.

In a new series on S4C - Lle Bach Mawr (A Big Little Place) which is aimed at inspiring us to renovate, build and transform – three of Wales's most creative people have been challenged to change a small space in their back gardens into a beautiful bolthole.

The three who are facing this task are the designer Gwyn Eiddior who spent lockdown at his family's farm in Garndolbenmaen, Gwynedd; the creative carpenter Carwyn Lloyd Jones from Bow Street, Ceredigion and the interior designer Mandy Watkins from Gaerwen, Anglesey.

name: Betrayal: Secrets & Lies
summary: The series follows lives undone by unthinkable betrayals and the courage it takes to survive scandalous confessions, secret lives, terrifying acts of violence, financial ruin and more.

name: World War II with Tom Hanks
summary: For eighty years, the Second World War has remained the most devastating and defining conflict in human history. World War II with Tom Hanks is a landmark documentary event that reexamines the war through the lens of a new century. Told over twenty hours and guided by Tom Hanks, whose lifelong passion for this history has shaped some of the most profound screen portrayals of the era, the series captures the full arc of the war — from the rise of fascism in Europe to the fall of Berlin, from Pearl Harbor to Hiroshima, and the uneasy peace that follows. Each episode uncovers new dimensions of the conflict: the decisions that shaped the battlefield, the unseen networks that sustained the war effort, and the aftershocks that still shape our world today. "World War II with Tom Hanks" is the definitive retelling of that story for a new generation: a sweeping, deeply human portrait of how the modern world was forged in the fires of global war.

name: L'Été 36
summary: Summer 1936, Nice. The vacationing bourgeoisie, accustomed to the French Riviera and its refined privileges, is bewildered by the influx of new holidaymakers taking advantage of the first paid vacations. In this hustle and bustle, where two worlds coexist without attempting to understand one another, four women from different backgrounds become embroiled in a murder at the very chic Hotel Riviera. A crime that will completely turn their family life, romantic relationships, and professional lives upside down.

name: Call of Destiny
summary: Crime profiler Fong Yat-chun receives a bizarre distress call, and the caller is astonishingly from the future. They predict brutal murders are going to take place! Yat-chun teams up with female detective Ying Ho-lam and forensics assistant Chong Ding-kan to prevent the deadly incidents from happening. But the perpetrator gets a head start and commits crime. Yat-chun eventually ascertains the caller's true identity. He also finds out Ho-lam is going to get into trouble. And Yat-chun knows his destiny as well. However, Yat-chun loses contact with the caller from the future. The perpetrator is getting closer and closer to them! The death clock begins to count down. Successive homicides that are difficult to crack take place. Yat-chun has to race against time as he wants to change the future by tracking down the perpetrator as soon as possible.

name: The Last Hunt for Nazi Gold
summary:
The Last Hunt for Nazi Gold follows historian Guy Walters and Justine Ostrowska on a 4,000-kilometre journey across Europe, chasing legends of hidden Nazi treasure.

From the mines of Germany and the Amber Room mysteries of Czechia, to stolen art in Austria, the Gold Train myths of Poland, bunker hunts in Italy, and the infamous waters of Lake Toplitz, their search combines discovery and eccentric encounters. Though every site yields more myth than treasure, the series reveals how obsession, paranoia, and history intertwine.

name: Vicky Pattison: Maybe, Baby?
summary: Vicky Pattison and her husband Ercan Ramadan face a big decision; should they start a family? As they explore the routes to parenthood and the realities of having kids, will they decide it's for them?

name: Spymasters: The Great Spy Writers
summary:
Spymasters: The Great Spy Writers explores the lives, works, and secrets of some of the most brilliant spy authors in literature.
They have shaped what has become a hugely popular genre, weaving intricate plots, clandestine operations, and intense suspense into their novels, and sometimes exploring political issues and international relations with unsettling and often cynical insight.

Successful film and television franchises have been built around spies, while spy novels sell in great numbers. Lying behind recurring plots based on the successful negotiation of risk and betrayal safely exposed is an altogether bleaker world, based on violence, and incessant surveillance by state actors to benefit state activities.

The series explores the interlocking world of public and private, state and individual and combines analysis of the biographies of the writers and their work, together with an examination of the geopolitical settings in which they operate.

name: Our Sticky Love
summary: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.

name: Britain's Murder Map
summary:
In a unique historical crime series, Vicky McClure and her historian husband, Jonny Owen, travel the UK exploring historic, culturally significant crimes that have changed the face of modern Britain.

The married couple investigate unsolved murders, miscarriages of justice and milestone cases that have changed the law. Speaking to experts, historians, police officers and victims' families, they examine the lasting impact each murder has left on the community and why these cases still resonate today. 

Joining Vicky and Jonny across their journey through these crimes are a range of contributors, including Trainspotting author Irvine Welsh, historians Dr Fern Riddell, Huw Williams, Phil Carradice, criminologist Professor David Wilson and more, as well as families of both victims and suspects.

name: Relatively Speaking
summary: Gordon Burns hosts Relatively Speaking, in which two family teams have their powers of observation, communication, and logic put to the test as they compete for the chance to win a holiday.

name: Mei Gui Cang Yu Hui Jin
Feng Zong，Tai Tai Gen Ni Li Hun Hen Jiu Le
Flags of Glory
summary: In 1950, Wei Zhenghua took on the identity of Zheng Xiongcai to join the Korean War. On the battlefield, he earned glory through countless acts of bravery, yet endured the agony of loss: brothers in arms scattered, comrades and loved ones sacrificed. Alongside his fellow soldiers, he fought through blood and fire, thwarting enemy conspiracies and a biological warfare campaign, culminating in a decisive victory. In 1953, the war ended. Seven decades later, a white-haired Wei Zhenghua unfurls his battle flag, honoring the fallen and paying tribute to a hard-won peace.

name: The Dark Romance
summary: In the process of investigating the truth about the suicide of her best friend and the arson by her student, single mother Yan Ling falls into the trap of emotional manipulation by a pick-up artist. In the entanglement of love and hate, she gradually awakens and regains her life.

name: It's Adam and Shelley
summary: Character-based sketch show created and performed by the brother-and-sister double-act, Adam and Shelley Longworth.

name: A konyha ördöge
summary: In the internationally renowned television format, Tamás Bereznay Hungarian star chef's task is to help struggling or only seemingly well-functioning restaurants, even to save them from bankruptcy by taking on all conflicts and awkward situations.

name: Love Destiny
summary: Great is a modern, optimistic surgeon from the year 2025 who's always happy to help others. After an accident befalls him, he winds up in the body of Phor Kaew, a man living in the past, despised by all of Ayutthaya. Unsuccessful in finding a way to return to the present, to survive in Kaew's life and by being himself, he gradually comes to win over the people around him.

name: Bless
summary: They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

name: Southern Law
summary: Southern Law follows law enforcement officers across the South as they respond to calls, protect their communities, and face the realities of policing in one of the country's most dynamic regions.

name: Akane-banashi
summary: Akane Osaki, captivated since childhood by the magical performances of her father, Shinta Arakawa, witnesses a shocking incident during his decisive performance for promotion to shin'uchi (master rank). Six years later, now a high school student, she sets her sights on becoming a shin'uchi herself—pushing forward in the highly competitive world of rakugo.

name: Love In Bloom
summary: On a rainy day, two strangers meet. As blossoms begin to bloom, love quietly takes root between them. But when a long-buried truth comes to light, they must decide what comes next, for their love, and for themselves.

name: Donna Hay Coastal Celebrations
summary: Best-selling Australian cookbook author, Donna Hay hosts a series of sunny celebrations by the sea, where she styles and cooks delicious food in beautiful locations. With Sydney's harbour as the backdrop, Donna uses fresh produce to create simple and stunning food.

name: Dear Killer Nannies: Criado por sicarios
summary: A gripping coming-of-age series told through Juampi's perspective as a child, the son of Colombia's most notorious drug lord, Pablo Escobar Gaviria. As he grows up, Juampi's world begins to fracture, shaped by his father's expanding criminal empire and the constant presence of danger - embodied by the hitmen who serve as his "nannies." Featuring a stellar cast including John Leguizamo as Pablo Escobar Gaviria, the series explores loyalty, fear, and the loss of innocence, revealing the human cost of a childhood spent inside one of history's most infamous criminal legacies.

name: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
summary: Through heart-stopping stories, parents must come face to face with the horrible truth — that the child they loved has grown up to become a killer.

previousepisode.name: One Child in Heaven, One in Jail

name: Raising Chelsea
summary: Follow he nation's favourite 'nearly parents', Jamie Laing and Sophie Habboo, as they embrace their latest challenge and greatest joy to date... parenthood.

name: Alkhalati+
summary: The desert hides comically bizarre secrets. So when the fates call on a poet, a filmmaker, a guard and a young man to face them — where do they hide?

name: Sins of Kujo
summary: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

name: Dream Stage
summary: It tells the story of the strong bond between a Japanese male producer who was expelled from the industry for causing trouble in the past, and seven dropout trainees from a small Korean entertainment agency, who work together to pursue their dreams, transcending generations and nationalities.

name: Your Song
summary: Your Song is about everyday people, who, driven by their love and connection to a particular song, will step up to the stage and share their story with the world. Whether their track helped them through heartbreak, became their anthem of triumph, or reminds them who they are, Your Song is exactly that…. Your's.

name: Comedy InvAsian
summary: Comedy InvAsian is both a live and filmed series featuring the nation's top and most unique six Asian American comedians each performing a one-hour special. In an era where diversity in entertainment is a necessity, Comedy InvAsian is the brainchild effort of producers Koji Steven Sakai and Quentin Lee to showcase and celebrate the diversity of Asian American comedy in both genre and representation to the world.

name: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
summary: Curl up with a clutter of useless cats as they swear at the telly, debate life's most outrageous questions and cause chaos in the local community.

name: Barbershop
summary: Travis "Trav" Porter endeavors to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather, a legendary barber, at the iconic Calvin's barbershop in Chicago. And while the barbers are new, the shop remains just as lively, the customers just as argumentative, and the fades are still the dopest in the city — because at Calvin's, the community comes together for way more than just a haircut.

name: El círculo
summary: Four friends whose lives unravel after one of them posts a video implicating the Secretary of Defense in the murder of a famous actress. As they dig deeper, they find themselves entangled in a dangerous web of power, secrets, and betrayal.

name: The Husband
summary: Kang Tae Ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director engages in an extreme fight with a criminal with a human face to save his wife who was kidnapped right before divorce.

name: A legjobb ajánlat
summary: An art discovery show with real stories, diverse objects and creations, and serious business deals. The show is hosted by András Sváby, who personally visits and shows the objects and creations and the stories behind them.

name: REnoválók
summary: Properties and homes that have faded or simply become dull. Can we achieve the home renovation of our dreams without spending a fortune and sending our old belongings to the trash? From now on, yes. Our mission is to transform our tired, worn-out homes into something spectacular - all in the spirit of sustainability. The designers have three days and a maximum budget of half a million HUFs to renovate a selected room in each property. Every week, we visit the homes of one celebrity family and one ordinary family.

name: The Redemption Experiment: No One Leaves Clean
summary: Former convicts, shunned by society, confront lethal traps in a rehabilitation program that unravels their buried regrets and leads to a shocking, twisted fate.

name: Boom Box: Beats and Betrayal
summary: In this gripping true crime series, a London recording studio attracts local aspiring rappers, then entangles them in a web of buying and selling guns. Loyalties shift, truths emerge too late, leading to devastating consequences.

name: O Testamento: O Segredo de Anita Harley
summary: A mysterious inheritance draws a family into a web of secrets left behind by Anita Harley. As hidden truths begin to surface, each revelation threatens to change everything they thought they knew.

name: Kara Swisher Wants to Live Forever
summary:
Produced by EverWonder Studio, Kara Swisher Wants to Live Forever follows journalist Kara Swisher as she embarks on a deeply personal and sharply reported journey into the rapidly expanding world of longevity science and humanity's enduring quest to cheat death.

"When my father died of an aneurysm at 34 years old, I was only five years old. Since then, I've thought a lot about death and how it impacts us all, for better or worse," said Swisher.  "When I started covering Silicon Valley in the early 1990s, I spent a lot of time reporting on how innovation and tech leaders could help some people while hurting others. As titans who have profoundly impacted our world, they've become interested in applying their vast fortunes and often god-like know-how to longevity, dreaming they might even be able to hack death itself. Can they? Is that a good thing? What is actual breakthrough science and what is the same old snake oil? Will that effort help all of humanity or just themselves? My goal is the same as it always has been: To find out."

Inspired by her own experiences confronting mortality, Swisher investigates the promises and pitfalls of the booming longevity industry. Across the series, Swisher examines everything from anti-aging treatments and biotech breakthroughs to the role of artificial intelligence, the influence of Silicon Valley, and the growing cultural obsession with extending life. Along the way, she explores how wealth, access to healthcare, and social connection shape who benefits from these innovations, and whether humanity's pursuit of longer lives is changing how we think about death itself.

Throughout the series, Swisher sits down with a range of voices at the center of the longevity conversation, including OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, entrepreneur Bryan Johnson, CRISPR pioneer and Nobel Prize winner Jennifer Doudna, entrepreneur and professor Scott Galloway, and Reed Jobs, whose work is shaped by his family's personal encounter with cancer. The series takes Swisher from exclusive concierge medical clinics to cutting-edge biotech labs and international healthcare systems, including a visit to South Korea to examine how preventative care and innovation have contributed to the country's high life expectancy.

name: Первая ракетка
summary: 17-year-old tennis player Katya is forced to quit the sport. Her family has neither money, nor connections, nor even the desire to fight for her dream of the world of big sports. Now tennis has become a way of survival for the girl. Pretending to be a beginner, Katya goes to private courts in Moscow and beats rich amateurs for money. Witnessing one of such "duels" is a former professional athlete Igor Strelnikov - a tired coach who has long dreamed of finding a truly gifted child. When he sees Katya, he realizes that she is the "unpolished diamond" and his chance to return to the world of professional sports. Igor makes the biggest bet of his career on Katya...

name: Didn't They Do Well
summary: Bruce Forsyth hosts this amusing, fast-moving general-knowledge quiz that uses a wealth of classic - and best-forgotten - TV moments to test three couples battling one another for a top prize of potentially £32,000.

name: The Northumbria Mysteries
summary:
Set against the sweeping Northumberland coastline and its surrounding market towns, the series centres on an unlikely crime-solving duo.

Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades whose life has been shaped by mistakes, regrets and missed opportunities, alongside Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a rarefied intellectual, a deep thinker with a brilliant mind and an ice-cool disposition.

In a classic odd-couple pairing, Joe and Rose combine their talents as they frustrate, confound and ultimately surprise one another while unravelling a series of compelling crime mysteries.

name: Dark City
summary: The dark side of a place lies not only in poverty, but also within human desires. Each story will bring out the truth and revelation of the dark side of humanity that they wish to hide. Some stories hit close...

name: Bomb Squad: Zero Hour
summary:
In this gripping documentary series, we're on the frontline with some of the most elite units of the British Army and Royal Navy; the bomb disposal squads who face over 2,500 bomb emergencies each year. These men and women put their lives on the line every day of the week to keep us safe.

With emotional testimony from survivors of major wars and terror attacks, coupled with dramatic footage of war zones and inner-city massacres, we also meet the military personnel who served across the world risking everything to keep others safe.

Packed with high-octane drama, explosions, and life-or-death moments that will leave viewers breathless, you'll be glad these real-life heroes are out there protecting us 24/7.

name: Rilakkuma
summary: Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

name: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
summary: In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Sung-jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest" screen to become an army cook. With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.

name: Angel Hare
summary: Jonah has discovered a nostalgic TV show that he'd all but forgotten about. The show hadn't forgotten him, though, and an investigation is about to take him deep down the rabbit hole.

previousepisode.name: The Christmas Case - Out of Office

name: Чем заняться в выходные?
summary: A TV travel guide that provides viewers with information on how to have a vacation with any budget and family size, without complicated logistics or long-distance flights. The program's participants embark on short trips or find options for staying in the city. Some of them dream of extreme activities, while others seek family adventures or want to explore or try new things.

name: Dour
summary: This is the story of three conflicted men on an intense chase revolving around a missing car. What is the mystery behind this car?

name: Invasion Iowa
summary: William Shatner spoofs a whole midwestern town (Riverside, Iowa, the birth place of his Star Trek character, Captain Kirk), who think he is there to shoot a big-budget action adventure film.

name: Импровизаторы
summary: In each episode, improvisers will have a new star guest who will prepare unexpected tasks for them. The characters do not suspect what exactly they will have to play, because in this project there is absolutely no script and no time to prepare.

name: Departament Amades
summary: A seemingly useless office hides a secret mission: to control Catalan mythological beings.

name: Efrag
summary: After 15 years behind bars, Abbas El Rayyes walks free—stained with the blood of his family. With his cousin's help, he seeks redemption, only to confront a world far darker than his prison cell.

name: Scotty With The Baby
summary: Scotty with the Body becomes Scotty with the BABY as she embarks on a new journey of motherhood.

name: ДИАГНОЗ
summary: Diagnosis is a show in which Alexander Dzidzaria and his guests discuss common diseases, epidemics, and pandemics in modern society, their origins, development, and impact on the world, as well as share stories from their own experiences.

name: Теория музыки
summary: This is a new show from the Rules of Life magazine team and VK Music. In it, we will talk about the main events from the world of music.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск №8. Музыкальный дайджест с Антоном Беляевым

name: ПОДКАСТ ЧАБДАРОВА
summary: A podcast about roads, jokes, and time that won't let go

name: Club Cumming
summary: Club Cumming, a tiny Lower East Side hotspot founded by Alan Cumming, is where bold performers chase big dreams. Blending rising talent with established stars, the club serves as a creative home for a diverse group of artists navigating ambition, relationships, and chosen family in a fast-paced docuseries.

name: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
summary: U.S. Againt the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team exclusively chronicles the United States Men's National Soccer Team (USMNT) in the leadup to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America this June. Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport's signature global event.

name: Wait, What?
summary: Wait, What? is back! Join Kimora Blac and Derrick Barry as they go head-to-head in all-new pop quizzes covering everything from LGBTQ+ history to third-grade math.

name: Take the Money and Run
summary: In October 2017, Dr. Ruja Ignatova vanished without a trace. The 37-year-old was worth 20 billion at the time and still tops the list of the most wanted women in the world. Wild stories continue to swirl around the gifted young woman who called herself the Cryptoqueen and Bitcoin Killer. Under the guise of giving the unbanked access to financial markets and helping them get rich, she scammed the world, especially small investors, out of billions. A few individuals, however, did get super-rich with her. Take the Money and Run tells her story: The rise and fall of one of the crypto world's most dazzling figures.

name: Always a Catch!
summary: Born into a legendary ducal family, martial prodigy Maria "Mimi" Annovazzi loses her claim as heir and is suddenly ordered to marry into prestige. With no options left in her homeland, she transfers to a neighboring kingdom—only to be publicly dumped at graduation by a prince she's never met over an engagement she didn't even know she had! Will Maria be doomed to the life of a spinster?!

previousepisode.name: How I Punched My Way into Marrying a Prince

name: Cooper - Just Like That
summary: Mixture of music, comedy and magic, starring Tommy Cooper.

name: My Ribdiculous Reincarnation
summary: The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications. The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples.

name: DreaMars
summary: Eight teenagers who fly to Mars for a critical mission in preparation for settlement on the Red Planet.

name: The Secrets of Hotel 88
summary: Once torn apart by betrayal, Michael and Federico reunite at the reopening of Hotel 88, the seaside dream they built together. With an unexpected announcement hanging from the two former best friends, their children are left on edge.

name: Reverse
summary: Ham Myo Jin lost her parents in a mysterious accident when she was a child. For 15 years, she has endured, only thinking about revenge. The perfect opportunity presents itself, but... She is involved in a car accident and loses all her memories. New facts are encountered in the process of chasing lost memories. Driven by crises, they are forced to come close to a shocking truth.

name: Absolute Value of Romance
summary: A quiet student by day, a romance novelist by night, Eui-ju is inspired when four gorgeous teachers appear: icy Woo-su, lively Da-ju, gruff Gi-jeon, and gentle Dong-ju. She writes them into her new novel, which blows up overnight! But her secret is discovered by Woo-su, her worst enemy since day one. She accepts his deal to protect her secret, but can she finish this novel unscathed?

name: Payback
summary: Sun, a debt collector, loses his younger brother after one of his debtors fatally stabs him. His boyfriend, Bank, betrays him and runs away with his money. To pay for his mother's medical treatment, Sun himself falls into debt. 5 years later, Sun works as a deliveryman and crosses paths with Bank again. He is now a famous actor under Dream Entertainment. Upon discovering that Bank was involved in the incident that led to his brother's death, Sun decides to enter the entertainment industry to exact revenge. There, he meets Jay, who is secretly the executive director of Dream Entertainment. From constant clashes, Sun and Jay slowly develop an irresistible attraction. Sun discovers that Jay is the same man he once encountered 5 years ago, while dressed in a rabbit mascot costume.

name: Sou Shen Ji
summary: In the barbaric era where the Flame Emperor and the Yellow Emperor lived, heroes vie for the throne in the Central Plains. When the world-recognized leader, Emperor Shennong, passes away, the heroes of the Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth clans are all ready to make a move. In this turbulent era, a young boy named Tuoba Ye is born. By chance, he is appointed the successor by Emperor Shennong at his deathbed, thus beginning a thrilling legend.

name: Xian Jian Qi Xia Zhuan San
091: Alerta Policía
summary: Follow the real cases of the men and women of the Policía Nacional as they fight crime, maintain law and order and risk their lives to help others.

name: Thunder Road
summary: Thunder Road follows the multi-generational saga of the Whitlock family, whose legacy in stock car racing is as deep as the family's ties to the southern hill country roots that shaped them. It features family dynamics, fierce rivalries, and the untold stories behind one of America's most iconic sports.

name: Scandal love
summary: In the highly commercialized idol industry, emotions are often manufactured and sold as part of the brand. Scandal Love follows four women navigating different levels of power within a K-pop girl group system. As they struggle with strict contracts, overwhelming public scrutiny, and their own genuine feelings, each is forced to make impossible choices. The series explores one central question: can real love survive inside relationships that are carefully designed and controlled?

name: Finder Series
summary: Twenty-three-year old Takaba Akihito is a young freelance photographer who takes pride in his work and seeks to get a major "scoop." After he takes photographs of the business dealings of crime lord Asami Ryuichi, Asami kidnaps and rapes him, beginning a sadomasochistic relationship between them as they find themselves continually drawn to one another. Fei Long, a rival Chinese boss who blames Asami for his father's death, takes an interest in Takaba, as well, seeking a way to get revenge.

previousepisode.name: You're My Love Prize of One Wing

name: Kirepapa
summary: The beauty Chisato Takatsukasa thinks that every guy that gets close to his only son, Riju just wants to take advantage of him. He is constantly chasing away the friends and potential suitors that Riju brings home; although, there is one guy who just refuses to give up, or so it seems, until it is Chisato who gets professed to. What happens between the beautiful father, the son, and his best friend is anyone's guess.

name: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
summary: A second-hand pair of earphones connects two rivals to the world of the dead. When their idol friend dies under mysterious circumstances, what starts as enemies forced to "fake date" turns into an undeniable bond as they become reluctant partners in a murder investigation. Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".

name: Kizuna
summary: From childhood friends (since elementary) to lovers (since high school), Kei and Ranmaru have been through a long road consisting of hardships and fond memories. Now in college, they face a new challenge to their relationship when the son of a Yakuza boss (and incidentally Kei's half-brother), Kai, attempts to steal Ranmaru from Kei (and, of course, fails). Ranmaru is the best fencer in his school. One day while he and his friend, Enjoji, are walking home from school, Yakuza from a rival syndicate try to run his friend over with their car. Ranmaru pushed his friend out of the way and gets hit instead. This event sparks the romance between Ranmaru and Enjoji. A few years later the relationship between them is still strong until Enjoji's half-brother, Kai, shows up and trys to take Ranmaru away from Enjoji. Then Masa, Kai's companion and mentor, shows up to see Kai.

name: A Moonlight Nights Passing
summary: A neglected housewife and a sharp‑tongued bar owner hit the road to Osaka—only to collide with a murder mystery straight out of Japan's literary canon. Equal parts suspense and self‑discovery, this "literary road trip" blends crime, comedy, and classic wisdom into a journey that heals old regrets.

name: After School in the Teacher's Lounge
summary: Kazama Toshiaki has fallen in love with his co-worder Kawase Mitsuro and confesses his feelings for him. They're both teachers at an all-girls school and male. The pressures of society come bearing down on them. Will their love ever survive these obstacles and their feelings of insecurity?

name: Earthian
summary: Angels from the planet Eden have been watching Earthians, the inhabitants of Earth, for 5 billion years. Chihaya, an angel with unlucky black hair and wings, is a plus checker who travels to Earth with Kagetsuya, a minus checker. Each team of plus and minus checkers keep track of Earth events and, if the score ever reaches minus 10,000, the Earth will be destroyed. The story follows Chihaya and Kagetsuya and the different people and events they observe on Earth.

name: Dick and Dom's Funny Business
summary: Dick and Dom's Funny Business finds the dynamic duo in a theatre running their own comedy business, showcasing the cream of the new British comedy crop. Each week their venue will play host to an established comedy star and brand new sketch acts.

name: Team Moms
summary: Team Moms launches viewers into the world of nationally competitive youth baseball via immersion into the Legendary Prep Academy in Scottsdale, Arizona's first and only baseball prep school. The series follows the coaches, founders and a group of dynamic families and their respective teen sons who comprise the starting lineup for one of the most competitive youth baseball programs in the world—a feeder to Division 1 college scholarships, NIL deals and ultimately, fame and fortune in the MLB. Willing to do whatever it takes for their children to excel at America's favorite pastime, the intensity of the program is only paralleled by the fervor of its athlete's parents, who will stop at nothing to ensure their kids make it to the big leagues.

name: Deceptive Marriage
summary: June is a wedding organizer who is assigned to plan and coordinate the wedding for the hottest of couple of the year, Pat and Note. Pat is a famous actress and her boyfriend, Note, is a not very successful cartoonist. After 3 years of dating, they announced that it was time for them to get married. After the announcement, the couple became even more popular. All kinds companies wanted them as a couple to be their product presenters. Many event organizers also wanted them to make appearances on their events. When Pat broke up with Note, they could not let the public know because they still were under contract as a couple… They would lose lots of money if the truth came out. Pat and Note continued with their charade. The marriage would be in name only.

name: Sao Noi in the City
summary: After New had left Bangkok for the countryside because of "Bangkok Allergy," he fell in love with Praew, a provincial girl. They both got married and promised to live in the country til they were old. However, before the newly-wed couple had a chance to move into their bridal house, New was immediately called back to Bangkok because Nu, his brother, who managed the luxury hotel, which is their family business, was sick. New had to temporarily work at the hotel, so he asked Praew to accompany him. However, she can't tell anyone that she is New's wife, as she's not recognized by his society. When she starts to feel as if she is the odd one, her innocent and adorable look catches the attention of Krist, a television producer and a famous starmaker.

name: Majurat Holiday
summary: The God of Death, guarding the 9th circle of hell, once decides to take a day off and go to earth, where he collides with weather oddities, colds, and also meets a girl and falls in love with her.

name: Game of Succession
summary: Mekhin was believed to be the next chairman of H Group, a powerful corporation. Devoting his life to the family, he risked everything—only to be denied the position upon discovering he was not a true heir by blood. When the tycoon was murdered, he planned to steal and alter the will, but a third party got there first. To recover it, he uses Monmeena, the thief's daughter, as leverage—unaware she will change his life and reveal a family secret he never imagined.

name: Michael Jackson: An American Tragedy
summary: Michael Jackson's journey from child prodigy to global pop icon - examining the genius, controversy, trials and tragedy that shaped and continue to divide his legacy.

name: I Made It at Market
summary: Turning passions into profits. Dom Chinea revisits amazing makers who have turned their talents into successful businesses, seeing how their skills have changed their lives.

previousepisode.name: Traditional Stone Carving and Stained Glass

name: New-Gen
summary: Twin brothers live a double life as ordinary teenagers and nanotech-enhanced superheroes while a demonic overlord uses Earth to stage his takeover of the twins' homeworld, NEW-GEN.

name: Jinn Wedding
summary: A traditional singer in Kuwait receives a strange invitation on her day off to perform at a wedding with her band. She reluctantly agrees but unbeknownst to her the people at the wedding are not human at all...

name: Great Japanese Railway Journeys
summary: Great Japanese Railway Journeys is a wide-ranging exploration of a country synonymous with rail innovation. The series starts with Michael in Osaka, he journeys from Kyoto's imperial heritage to Hiroshima's Peace Memorial Park, from the volcanic landscapes of Kyushu to the vast urban system of Tokyo, before continuing through the Seikan Tunnel to Hokkaido. Along the way, he explores a nation where technological innovation and long-held tradition sit side by side, using the railway to connect stories that have shaped modern Japan.

name: Shrift the Thrift
summary: Couples scour the UK's charity shops to see if they can make even more money at auction for the items they purchase and raise money for their chosen causes.

name: American Made
summary: An intimate look into the lives and businesses of visionary Americans rekindling the American dream, one quality American Made product at a time.

name: The Corrections
summary: The Corrections is a sharply comic portrait of a Midwestern family whose three unmoored adult siblings desperately resist their mother's wish for one last Christmas together – each undone by the delusional ambitions that were supposed to save them from becoming their parents.

name: The Witch Farm
summary:
South Wales, 1989. Bill and Liz Rich leave London for Heol Fanog, a remote modern farmhouse in the foothills of the Brecon Beacons, determined to make a fresh start. At first, the isolation feels like freedom. But when, in the midst of a traumatic home birth, Liz becomes convinced she's seen a ghostly figure in the bedroom they start to feel increasingly afraid…

What follows is a steady escalation of the chillingly uncanny - unexplained disturbances and an unsettling sense that they are not alone. As Bill and Liz begin to investigate, the house draws them deeper into a history that refuses to stay buried. And as the land yields its secrets, so too does their marriage - testing the limits of trust, belief, and what they're willing to deny in order to survive.

name: Regards d'enfance
summary: This collection addresses the problems of our time and the difficulties encountered by parents seen through the eyes of children, while trying to describe in each film a different and specific socio-professional environment.

name: The Hidden Blood
summary: Young Meen is the unknowing carrier of a Pob bloodline. When love begins to grow in her heart, her body undergoes sudden changes. As the Pob within Meen continues its awakening, she craves to possess, craves to protect—she hungers and thirsts. Mira, a girl too close to Meen, may become the one to cause the monster within Meen to awaken when uncontrollable feelings become too much to suppress Meanwhile, mysterious Sydney reappears bearing the vampiric powers of an ancient lineage. She's torn between following the orders of Daddy, her bloodline's owner, and Teacher Pan, the one her heart has never forgotten. A group of friends face mysterious forces, secrets, jealousy, and fear of what is taking shape around them, not knowing who is a friend and who is a monster.

name: Old Town Murders
summary:
When DI Glyn Walsh returns unexpectedly early from bereavement leave, he and DS Sion Dearden work together to solve the perplexing murder of an esteemed University Professor. The case takes the pair on a complex investigation into the underbelly of the local University to track down the killer.

Once the killer is found, there is no time to rest, as the pair are called to more murder mysteries across the area. From the poisoning of a local Head Teacher who inexplicably drowns whilst wild swimming, to a mystifying case of mistaken identity during a triathlon, the pair must navigate working and living under the same roof while solving a slew of baffling murder cases.

Set against the stunning backdrop of modern-day Tenby, West Wales, Old Town Murders explores finding meaning, purpose and hope later in life through friendship and solving crime.

name: Francis Bourgeois & Chris Harris: We Saved A Train
summary: Trainspotting star Francis Bourgeois teams up with petrolhead Chris Harris to restore a wrecked locomotive, built in 1961.

name: Paul Merton: Driving Amazing Trains
summary: Paul Merton climbs into the driver's cab to take charge of some of the world's most iconic locomotives, learning what it takes to keep them running and meeting the people who keep the railways running.

name: Sharp Downpour
summary: Suffering from a chronic "nightmare disorder," police officer Lu Yi has spent years secretly investigating the truth behind her father's mysterious coma. Her path crosses with Lin Shen, a cold and aloof female detective, and the two join forces to solve a series of bizarre homicides. As their bond deepens, Lu Yi begins to uncover unsettling clues. There are hints that Lin Shen may be inextricably linked to her father's long-buried case...

name: Hell's Gate
summary: Living under an authoritarian regime in 2052 Beirut, a secluded man's life changes when a technical failure brings a fugitive woman to his doorstep.

name: Great Korean Railway Journeys
summary: Great Korean Railway Journeys sees Michael travel the length of South Korea, beginning in the Demilitarised Zone through Seoul and beyond on high-speed trains exceeding 200 miles per hour. From a peninsula defined by division and war to a capital transformed by rapid development, he examines South Korea's emergence as a global force in technology and culture. Visiting ancient royal sites, industrial centres and major ports, and continuing to Busan and Jeju Island, he traces stories of resilience, reinvention and national identity.

name: Great Central Asian Railway Journeys
summary: Michael travels through Uzbekistan in Great Central Asian Railway Journeys, tracing routes that echo the ancient Silk Road. This series sees Michael embarking on an epic railway exploration through the heart of Central Asia. Crossing desert landscapes and historic cities, he explores a region shaped by empire, trade and faith. Through encounters along the line, he examines how modern railways now link places that were once at the crossroads of the world.

name: Le Jeu de la vérité
summary: The idea was for a media personality of the moment to come on the show and answer questions live from the studio audience or by phone.

name: Das Zweite Attentat
summary: It tells the story of Alex, a young man who tries to find out the truth about the murder of his father, who was a sniper for the Bundeswehr.

name: My Brother the Minotaur
summary: A thrilling mix of folklore, mystery and adventure about a young minotaur – half boy, half bull – found and raised in the human world. With the help of his fiercely loyal human brother, he recruits a bold group of friends to uncover the mystery of his minotaur past and fulfill his destiny, all while battling dark forces determined to see him fail.

name: 24 en 24
summary:
24 chefs take on 24 challenges in 24 hours to try and win a grand prize.

In this unique culinary competition hosted by Chuck Hughes and Julie Bélanger, each chef will have to push their limits to stay in the kitchen. Watch it on TVA.

name: Jane McDonald in Nashville
summary:
Yee-haw! Saddle up partners, as singer and presenter Jane McDonald travels to Nashville, to discover why millions of tourists flock to the Tennessee capital each year. 

Jane is the ultimate holidaymaker, seeing the sights and meeting the people who call this place home. 

Country fan Jane also takes us to the recording studio and behind-the-scenes of her latest album. It's a dream come true and, as northern lass, Jane embraces everything Nashville has to offer, but she might find that she's a southern country gal at heart.

name: Incognito
summary: In search of redemption, a crew of misfits joins a private military company on a series of deadly missions against the criminal underworld.

name: Survivor Germany
summary: Far removed from civilization, without comfort, without contact with the outside world, and equipped with only the bare necessities, courageous participants face the ultimate challenge: Survivor. Against a spectacular natural backdrop, they battle not only hunger, weather, and exhaustion, but also each other. Who will endure, who will rise to the occasion, and who will be eliminated?

name: Captain James Cook
summary: Based on Captain James Cook's three voyages. It was on his first voyage, in 1770 (while in the South Pacific region to observe the transit of Venus), that Captain Cook discovered the east coast of Australia. He later recommended Australia as a future British colony. Made principally on location, using a full-size replica of the 'Endeavour' (built for the Australian bicentenary), this has a salty atmosphere lacking from many historial 'sea dramas'. Michell's performance as the titular Yorkshireman has also been praised for its complexity.

name: Deceit
summary: Harry goes missing at sea shattering the life of his family.

name: D'un zoo à l'autre
summary: Lloyd and Alice venture to Australia to work with its unique animals! Kangaroos, koalas, wombats, Tasmanian devils: their journey will take them to various sanctuaries to treat the injured and care for orphans.

name: Trend to ร่างทอง
summary: From fitness trends to eating for strength and good health, Sky Wongravee and guests chat and show viewers how to transform their figures into their golden prime.

name: He Li Hou，Ta Guan Jue Jing Cheng
Judgment: Cases That Changed Australia
summary: Judgment takes viewers inside the High Court of Australia, where our country answers many of its toughest questions and where ordinary citizens seeking justice challenge the laws that have shaped our nation. Across four of the most high-stake cases – Gay Rights & Marriage Equality, Mabo, Immigration Detention and the Right to Vote– Judgment charts the personal battles that have become constitutional turning points driving change in the course of history.

name: Perfect Adultery
summary: Chiharu Yoshioka and Takuya have been happily married for three years. However, without Takuya's knowledge, Chiharu has been having multiple affairs which she believes help her to continue loving her husband and continue their marriage. One day, Takuya hears from a friend that it is normal for people to commit adultery in today's society. Despite finding nothing in his wife's phone, Takuya realizes that has been caught in multiple traps set by his wife. This is a story of a wife who continues to have affairs to love her husband, and the husband, who continues to love his wife no matter how many times she has an affair.

name: Sweet Blood
summary: On the night of a blue moon lunar eclipse that happens once in ten years, the portal between the vampire world, where drinking human blood is forbidden, and the human world opens. Lucifer, a vampire prince who desperately craves human blood, descends into the human world. Min U, a university student in his early twenties, moves to the city from the countryside. He works tirelessly, day and night, to save up for tuition while also studying hard. However, Min U contracts a rare disease that puts his life at risk whenever he bleeds. One day, Min U becomes a victim of a hit-and-run accident, bleeding and finding himself in a life-threatening situation. Lucifer, drawn by the scent of blood, attacks Min U. However, something strange happens: Lucifer collapses, and Min U miraculously survives, unharmed.

name: Venus's Groom
summary: Blinded by rage and consumed by the need to avenge his brother, Pakin kidnaps a luxury hotel heir, holding him captive in the unforgiving wilderness. But fate plays a cruel trick: his hostage might not be the culprit he believes he is. Beneath identical faces lies a stark difference one is a fire ready to burn, the other is water ready to heal. Can he tell them apart? And in the heart of the wild, how will forced proximity turn a sworn enemy into a lover?

name: Don't Mess With Senior
summary: This is a tale of a bright, courageous student who comes across some senior students who are pretty strict and unyielding. Despite the differences in their personalities, the junior is able to break through the barriers and positively influence the senior student. Meanwhile, the story explores the possibility of a romantic relationship between two girls, one of whom is a senior. However, the senior hesitates to accept the younger student's feelings, leading to a complicated situation.

name: Hidden Obsession
summary: After three years of marriage to Gu Huanzhi without a child, Koukou was filled with anxiety about a potential divorce. Her secret publication of storybooks was exposed, drawing them closer. On their southern inspection tour, she saw his possessive side and recalled their past: his broken promise once left her in hardship. Learning of his years-long pursuit and sincere love, she let go of her resentment and vowed to grow old with him.

name: Blue Collar
summary: Blue Collar is a hard-hats-on, sleeves-rolled-up series that throws Canadian comedy star Dan Petronijevic into some of the country's toughest jobs. He's played working-class characters on screen for years but now there's no script, no stunt doubles and no, ‘take two'.

previousepisode.name: Guts of Steel – Multitech Trades Corp

name: Where the Wild Wind Blows
summary: After the unexpected death of her brother, Yan Rui is consumed by grief. At a guesthouse, she meets Duan Bo'an, the captain of a mountain patrol team. She deliberately draws close to him, while he quietly falls for her. With Duan Bo'an's support, Yan Rui overcomes her inner demons, and with Yan Rui's comfort, Duan Bo'an finally comes to terms with the loss of his sister. Just as they find healing in each other, a new crisis quietly approaches.

name: Paradise: Official Podcast
summary: Paradise actor, superfan and family member Ryan Michelle Bathé talks to the cast and crew that brought the spellbinding second season to life, from the show's biggest stars, like her husband Sterling K. Brown, to creator Dan Fogelman, and beyond.

name: The Gunfather: Restorations
summary: Meet Louie Tuminaro. He's a firearms restoration expert that truly believes every gun has a story to tell and a unique connection to the person who owns it. That's why each week, along with his team, he's going to restore a firearm, submitted by viewers, back to its original glory. This is The Gunfather: Restorations.

name: My Rival in Love is Me
Vitrerie Joyal
summary: In the mid-1990s, André Joyal, the owner of a glass shop, is trying to save his declining business while facing major family challenges in a fast-changing world. André must learn to let go, accept change and redefine what really matters in his life.

name: National Velvet
summary: A series about a girl named Velvet who, after acquiring a horse, dedicates herself to training and dreaming of the day it wins a great race. Based on Enid Bagnold's best- selling novel and the MGM film, the TV version has been moved in locale from England to an American dairy farm region. It remains, however, the simple heart-warming story of a 12-year-old girl, her horse, and her great dream of winning a famous steeplechase. Most of all, "National Velvet" is the story of the Brown family — Herbert Brown, a modestly successful dairy farmer, played by Arthur Space; his wife, Martha Brown, portrayed by veteran actress Ann Doran; Edwina Brown, Velvel's boy-crazy older sister, played by Carole Wells, and small Donald Brown, a role filled by 7-year- old Joey Scott. Handyman Mi Taylor, who abets Velvet in many of her plans concerning the beautiful horse, is played by James McCallion.

name: Naked and Afraid: Global Showdown
summary: Survivalists from all over the world - including Brazil, Australia, Mexico, and the United States - represent their homelands in a grueling 40-day primitive bushcraft competition. Paired with a partner, their skills, toughness and teamwork will be tested as they compete for national pride and the largest cash prize in franchise history.

name: Yamada-kun to 7-nin no Majo: Mou Hitotsu no Suzaku-sai
summary: The Mou Hitotsu no Suzaku‑sai OVAs are a two 30min bonus story episodes set around Suzaku High's school festival. The first episode follows Yamada and the Supernatural Studies Club as they go on a hot‑spring training camp before the festival, leading to the usual body‑swap chaos and light comedy. The second episode takes place during the actual festival, where the club gets involved in performances, events, and more supernatural mishaps. Together, they form a small, self‑contained comedic arc that exists separately from the TV anime's continuity.

previousepisode.name: Second Coming of the Suzaku Festival: Sing! Dance! Supernatural Studies Club!
